name: A Night In The Turbolift
source:
A Night In The Turbolift is a visual novel rendering of the events of an imaginary episode of an imaginary Star Trek series.

[From [url=https://alimakesrpgs.itch.io/a-night-in-the-turbolift]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《涡轮升降机之夜》是一部视觉小说，描绘了虚构的《星际迷航》系列中虚构的一集的事件。

[来自[url=https://alimakesrpgs.itch.io/a-night-in-the-turbolift]itch.io[/url]]
